Zero-width characters — width 0, must not advance cursor:
ZWSP between letters: a​b​c​d (U+200B)
ZWNJ: ज्ञान vs ज‌्ञान (Devanagari conjunct vs broken)
ZWJ: श्र (Devanagari conjunct via ZWJ)
BOM at start: ﻿hello (U+FEFF — should be invisible)
RTL marker: text ‏ Arabic ‎ text — bidi controls
Soft hyphen: example‐word‐here (visible) vs example­word­here (only on break)
Variation selectors: ✋ vs ✋︎ (text presentation) vs ✋︉ (emoji presentation if supported)
